name: Ntọala Ịdị Mma Ọrụ (Nkwadebe maka Six Sigma Yellow Belt)
objectives: Mgbe e nyere gị nkọwa nke ọrụ mmezi, ịkpọ aha nzọụkwụ ise nke DMAIC n'usoro ma kwuo ihe na-eme na nke ọ bụla, ma nweta ise niile ziri ezi

Mgbe e nyere gị usoro nwere nsogbu na-emegharị, ide nkọwa nsogbu na ebumnuche a pụrụ ịtụ, ma see eserese usoro dị mfe, nwere gịnị, ebee, mgbe na otu o si buru ibu, na-enweghị ihe kpatara ya ma ọ bụ ngwọta n'ime nkọwa ahụ
Mgbe e nyere gị usoro ị ga-ele anya otu izu ruo izu abụọ, ịnakọta data na check sheet ma gbakọọ ọnụego ntụpọ, nwere opekata mpe data 20 ma gosi mgbakọ ya

Mgbe e nyere gị data check sheet gị, ịchọta nsogbu kacha ukwuu site na Pareto chart ma gwuo ruo isi nsogbu ya site na 5 Whys, nke mere na ihe kpatara a chọtara bụ nke otu ahụ nwere ike ime ihe banyere ya
Mgbe e nyere gị isi nsogbu, ịhọrọ mmezi na-ewepụ ihe efu ma ọ bụ mperi, nwalee ya n'obere ọnọdụ ma hazie nlele njikwa, nwere data tupu na mgbe mmezi ahụ gasịrị
Site n'iji peeji gọọmentị ASQ ma ọ bụ IASSC, ime atụmatụ ọmụmụ na ule nwere ụbọchị maka ule Yellow Belt, na ụdị ule na iwu ya a lelere na peeji ahụ

chapters.name: Isi 1: Kọwaa ma tụọ nsogbu ahụ

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 1: Ịdị mma, Six Sigma na nzọụkwụ ise nke DMAIC
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 1 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Kpọọ aha nzọụkwụ ise nke DMAIC ma kwuo ihe Yellow Belt na-eme na nke ọ bụla.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị nkọwa nke ọrụ mmezi, ị ga-enwe ike ịkpọ aha nzọụkwụ ise nke DMAIC n'usoro ma kwuo ihe na-eme na nke ọ bụla, ma nweta ise niile ziri ezi.
Ịdị mma pụtara inye onye ahịa ihe ọ chọrọ, n'otu ụzọ ahụ, oge niile. Ntụpọ (defect) bụ ihe ọ bụla onye ahịa agaghị anabata: ọda ezighi ezi, nnyefe na-egbu oge, akụkụ na-efu efu, mperi n'ụgwọ.
Six Sigma bụ usoro iji belata ntụpọ site n'iji data kama ịkọ nkọ. Lean bụ usoro iji belata ihe efu (waste), ya bụ nzọụkwụ na-agbakwunye oge mana ọ dịghị uru. Ọtụtụ ndị were mmadụ n'ọrụ na-akụzi ha ọnụ dị ka Lean Six Sigma.
Ọrụ mmezi na-agbaso nzọụkwụ ise a na-akpọ DMAIC: Define (kọwaa nsogbu), Measure (tụọ otu o si buru ibu), Analyze (nyochaa ka ịchọta isi nsogbu), Improve (mezie site n'ịnwale ngwọta), na Control (jikwaa iji debe uru ahụ). Belt na-egosi ọkwa ọzụzụ: Yellow Belt maara ntọala ma na-enyere aka n'ọrụ, ọtụtụ mgbe site n'ịnakọta data na ise eserese nzọụkwụ; Green Belt na Black Belt na-edu ọrụ ka ukwuu.
Asambodo Yellow Belt abụọ a ma ama bụ ASQ Certified Six Sigma Yellow Belt na IASSC Certified Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt. Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị; ọ bụ naanị ụlọ ọrụ na-enye asambodo na-enye ya.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Define: gịnị bụ nsogbu ahụ na ebumnuche ya?
- Measure: ugboro ole ka ọ na-eme ugbu a?
- Analyze: gịnị bụ isi nsogbu ya?
- Improve: kedu mmezi na-arụ ọrụ mgbe i nwalere ya?
- Control: kedu otu ị ga-esi debe uru ahụ?
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Ntụpọ (defect): ihe ọ bụla onye ahịa agaghị anabata, dị ka ihe ezighi ezi, nke gburu oge ma ọ bụ nke mebiri emebi.
- Six Sigma: usoro iji belata ntụpọ site n'iji data; ịdị mma dị elu nke ukwuu pụtara ihe dị ka ntụpọ 3.4 n'ime ohere otu nde.
- Lean: usoro iji wepụ nzọụkwụ na-emefu oge ma ọ bụ ihe eji arụ ọrụ.
- DMAIC: Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve, Control: nzọụkwụ ise nke ọrụ Six Sigma.
- Yellow Belt: onye a zụrụ na ntọala, na-enyere aka n'ọrụ mmezi.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- ASQ: Certified Six Sigma Yellow Belt (ihe a chọrọ, ule na Body of Knowledge)
- IASSC: Certified Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt (ICYB)
Nwaa ugbu a: Họrọ otu usoro ị maara nke na-ezighi ezi ugboro ugboro, n'ọrụ, n'azụmahịa ma ọ bụ n'ụlọ (dịka ọmụmaatụ ọda e zipụrụ n'oge gara aga, ọda nri ehihie ezighi ezi, ma ọ bụ akwụkwọ ụgwọ e zipụrụ na mperi). Dee ya n'elu peeji, wee dee D, M, A, I, C n'akụkụ ya, ya na otu ajụjụ ị ga-ajụ na nzọụkwụ ọ bụla.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịkpọ aha nzọụkwụ ise nke DMAIC n'usoro, ikwu ihe Yellow Belt na-eme, na ịhọrọ usoro ị ga-emezi.

check.q: Kedu usoro ziri ezi nke nzọụkwụ DMAIC?
check.why: DMAIC pụtara Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve, Control, n'usoro ahụ.

check.q: Otu gị na-anwale ụzọ ọhụrụ isi kwakọọ ọda ka ha hụ ma mperi ọ ga-ebelata. Kedu nzọụkwụ nke a bụ?
check.why: Ịnwale mmezi ka ịhụ ma ọ na-arụ ọrụ na-eme na nzọụkwụ Improve.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 2: Define: nkọwa nsogbu na eserese usoro
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 2 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Dee nkọwa nsogbu na ebumnuche, ma see eserese usoro dị mfe.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị usoro nwere nsogbu na-emegharị, ị ga-enwe ike ide nkọwa nsogbu na ebumnuche a pụrụ ịtụ, ma see eserese usoro dị mfe, nwere gịnị, ebee, mgbe na otu o si buru ibu, na-enweghị ihe kpatara ya ma ọ bụ ngwọta n'ime nkọwa ahụ.
Ezigbo ọrụ na-amalite site na nkọwa nsogbu doro anya. Ọ na-ekwu ihe na-ezighi ezi, ebee, kemgbe mgbe ole na otu o si buru ibu, na ihe mere o ji dị mkpa. Ọ NAGHỊ akpọ aha ihe kpatara ya ma ọ bụ ngwọta ugbu a, n'ihi na ị chọtabeghị ha. Ọmụmaatụ: "Kemgbe June, ọda nri ehihie 12 n'ime 100 ọ bụla n'ụlọ nri (cafe) dị n'etiti obodo na-apụ ezighi ezi, na-akpata nkwụghachi ego na mkpesa."
Ebumnuche ahụ na-ekwu otu o ga-esi ka mma, na mgbe: "Belata ọda nri ehihie ezighi ezi ruo 3 n'ime 100 ọ bụla tupu njedebe September."
Mgbe ahụ, see eserese usoro ahụ. Dee nzọụkwụ ọ bụla n'igbe site na mmalite ruo njedebe ma jikọọ ha na akụ (arrow). SIPOC bụ tebụl ngwa ngwa nke foto zuru ezu: Suppliers (ndị na-enye ihe), Inputs (ihe a na-etinye), Process (nzọụkwụ usoro), Outputs (ihe na-apụta) na Customers (ndị ahịa). Olu onye ahịa (VOC) bụ ihe ndị ahịa kwuru na ha chọrọ; akụkụ ndị kacha dị ha mkpa ka a na-akpọ critical to quality (CTQ).
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Dee ihe na-ezighi ezi, ebee, kemgbe mgbe ole na otu o si buru ibu.
- Tinye ihe mere o ji dị mkpa (ego, oge, ndị ahịa, nchekwa).
- Lelee: enweghị ihe kpatara ya na enweghị ngwọta na nkọwa ahụ.
- Dee ebumnuche nwere nọmba na ụbọchị.
- See usoro ahụ n'igbe 5 ruo 8, site na mmalite ruo njedebe.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Nkọwa nsogbu (problem statement): nkọwa dị mkpụmkpụ, dabere n'eziokwu, nke ihe na-ezighi ezi, ebee, mgbe na otu o si buru ibu.
- Eserese usoro (process map): eserese nke nzọụkwụ usoro n'usoro, site n'iji igbe na akụ.
- SIPOC: tebụl otu peeji nke Suppliers, Inputs, Process, Outputs na Customers.
- Olu onye ahịa (VOC): ihe ndị ahịa kwuru na ha chọrọ ma ọ bụ na-eme mkpesa banyere ya.
- Critical to quality (CTQ): akụkụ kacha dị onye ahịa mkpa, dị ka ịbịa n'oge ma ọ bụ ịdị ezi.
Nwaa ugbu a: Maka usoro ị họọrọ, dee nkọwa nsogbu nwere gịnị, ebee, kemgbe mgbe ole na otu o si buru ibu (jiri ihe kacha mma ị chere ugbu a), ebumnuche nwere nọmba na ụbọchị, na eserese usoro nwere igbe 5 ruo 8 n'akwụkwọ.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ide nkọwa nsogbu na ebumnuche, ma see eserese usoro dị mfe.

options: "Onye osi nri ọhụrụ anaghị akpachara anya."
"Kemgbe March, ngwaahịa 8 n'ime 50 ọ bụla e zipụrụ site n'ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa ọwụwa anyanwụ na-eru n'oge gara aga, na-akpata nkwụghachi ego nye ndị ahịa."
check.why: Ọ na-enye gịnị, ebee, kemgbe mgbe ole na otu o si buru ibu, ọ naghịkwa ata ihe kpatara ya ụta ma ọ bụ kpọọ aha ngwọta.

check.q: Gịnị ka P dị na SIPOC pụtara?
check.why: SIPOC bụ Suppliers, Inputs, Process, Outputs na Customers.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 3: Measure: check sheet na ọnụego ntụpọ
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 3 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Nakọta data na check sheet ma gbakọọ ọnụego ntụpọ.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị usoro ị ga-ele anya otu izu ruo izu abụọ, ị ga-enwe ike ịnakọta data na check sheet ma gbakọọ ọnụego ntụpọ, nwere opekata mpe data 20 ma gosi mgbakọ ya.
Na nzọụkwụ Measure, ị na-achọpụta ugboro ole nsogbu ahụ na-eme n'ezie. Ịkọ nkọ na-ezighi ezi ọtụtụ mgbe, ya mere ị na-agụ ọnụ.
Check sheet bụ fọm dị mfe n'akwụkwọ ma ọ bụ na spreadsheet. N'akụkụ, depụta ụdị ntụpọ dị iche iche (ihe ezighi ezi, ihe na-efu efu, igbu oge). N'elu, depụta ụbọchị. Dee akara (tally) oge ọ bụla otu n'ime ha mere, ma gụkwa ọnụ ihe niile i lelere.
Ọnụego ntụpọ bụ ihe nwere ntụpọ kewara n'ihe niile, mụbaa ya na 100. Ọ bụrụ na ọda 15 n'ime 200 ezighi ezi: 15 / 200 = 0.075, ma ọ bụ 7.5%. Six Sigma na-ejikwa DPMO, ntụpọ n'ime ohere otu nde: ntụpọ kewara n'(ihe x ohere n'otu ihe), mụbaa na 1,000,000. Ọ bụrụ na akwụkwọ ụgwọ 500 nwere ohere 4 nke mperi n'otu n'otu, i wee hụ mperi 10: 10 / (500 x 4) = 0.005, mụbaa na 1,000,000 = 5,000 DPMO.
Tụọ ya n'otu ụzọ ahụ oge niile: otu nkọwa ntụpọ ahụ, otu oge n'ụbọchị, otu onye ma ọ bụ iwu doro anya. Nke a bụ baseline gị, nọmba "tupu" ị ga-eji tụnyere ihe ọzọ ma emechaa.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Dee nkọwa doro anya nke ntụpọ ọ bụla.
- Mee check sheet: ụdị ntụpọ n'akụkụ, ụbọchị n'elu.
- Dee akara maka ntụpọ ọ bụla ma gụọ ọnụ ihe niile i lelere.
- Ọnụego ntụpọ = ihe nwere ntụpọ / ihe niile x 100.
- Dee nke a dị ka baseline gị.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Check sheet: fọm dị mfe maka ịgụ ọnụ ugboro ole ụdị nsogbu ọ bụla na-eme.
- Ọnụego ntụpọ (defect rate): òkè nke ihe nwere ntụpọ, e gosiri dị ka pasentị.
- DPMO: ntụpọ n'ime ohere otu nde: ntụpọ / (ihe x ohere n'otu ihe) x 1,000,000.
- Baseline: otu usoro ahụ si arụ ọrụ tupu i gbanwee ya.
Nwaa ugbu a: Mee check sheet maka usoro gị n'akwụkwọ ma ọ bụ na spreadsheet. Nakọta opekata mpe data 20 n'izu na-abịa (malite taa), wee gbakọọ ọnụego ntụpọ gị ma gosi mgbakọ ya. Mee omume ugbu a: nnyefe 9 gburu oge n'ime 150 bụ pasentị ole? (Azịza: 9 / 150 = 0.06 = 6%.)
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịnakọta data na check sheet, ịgbakọ ọnụego ntụpọ, na ịtọ baseline gị.

check.q: I lelere ọda 80, 4 n'ime ha ezighi ezi. Gịnị bụ ọnụego ntụpọ?
Gịnị mere ị na-ede otu nkọwa doro anya nke ntụpọ ọ bụla tupu ịgụ ọnụ?
options: Ka chart ahụ maa mma karị
Ka onye isi bịanye aka na ya
Ka onye ọ bụla gụọ ọnụ n'otu ụzọ ma nọmba ndị ahụ bụrụ ndị a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi
Ka ị chọọ data ole na ole
check.why: Ọ bụrụ na ndị mmadụ na-agụ ihe dị iche iche, a pụghị ịtụnyere data ahụ ma ọ bụ tụkwasị ya obi.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 4: Analyze: Pareto chart, fishbone na 5 Whys
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 4 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Chọta nsogbu kacha ukwuu site na Pareto chart na isi nsogbu ya site na 5 Whys.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị data check sheet gị, ị ga-enwe ike ịchọta nsogbu kacha ukwuu site na Pareto chart ma gwuo ruo isi nsogbu ya site na 5 Whys, nke mere na ihe kpatara a chọtara bụ nke otu ahụ nwere ike ime ihe banyere ya.
Pareto chart bụ chart nwere mkpanaka (bar) a haziri site na nke kacha ogologo ruo na nke kacha nta. Ọ na-egosi na ihe ole na ole na-akpatakarị ọtụtụ nsogbu, nke a na-akpọkarị iwu 80/20. Malite na mkpanaka kacha ogologo.
Eserese fishbone (ọkpụkpụ azụ; a na-akpọkwa ya eserese ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, ma ọ bụ Ishikawa) na-enyere otu aka ịdepụta ihe ndị nwere ike ịkpata nsogbu. Dee nsogbu ahụ n'"isi", wee see ọkpụkpụ maka otu ihe kpatara dị iche iche, dị ka Methods (ụzọ), Machines (igwe), Materials (ihe eji arụ ọrụ), People (ndị mmadụ), Measurement (ntụle) na Environment (gburugburu).
Wee jụọ "Gịnị mere?" ihe dị ka ugboro ise iji gwuo site n'ihe ịrịba ama ruo n'isi nsogbu ị nwere ike idozi. Ọmụmaatụ: Ọda ezighi ezi. Gịnị mere? Onye osi nri gụhiere tiketi. Gịnị mere? E ji aka dee tiketi ahụ. Gịnị mere? Igwe mbipụta mebiri emebi. Gịnị mere? Ọ dịghị onye e nyere ọrụ idozi ya. Gịnị mere? Enweghị nlele mmezi igwe. Isi nsogbu: enweghị nlele mmezi maka igwe mbipụta ahụ.
Ịta mmadụ ụta abụghị isi nsogbu. Ọ bụrụ na azịza ya bụ "mmadụ akpachaghị anya", nọgide na-ajụ ihe mere usoro ahụ ji kwe ka mperi ahụ mee.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Gbakọọ ụdị ntụpọ ọ bụla site na check sheet gị.
- Hazie ha site na nke kacha ukwuu ruo na nke kacha nta ma see mkpanaka ha.
- Họrọ mkpanaka kacha ogologo.
- Depụta ihe nwere ike ịkpata ya na fishbone.
- Jụọ "Gịnị mere?" ihe dị ka ugboro ise ruo mgbe ị ruru ihe kpatara ị nwere ike ime ihe banyere ya.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Pareto chart: chart mkpanaka a haziri site na nke kacha ukwuu ruo na nke kacha nta, iji gosi nsogbu ole na ole kacha dị mkpa.
- Iwu 80/20: ụkpụrụ na-egosi na ihe ole na ole na-akpatakarị ọtụtụ nsogbu.
- Eserese fishbone: eserese na-achịkọta ihe nwere ike ịkpata nsogbu; a na-akpọkwa ya eserese Ishikawa.
- Isi nsogbu (root cause): ezi ihe kpatara nsogbu; dozie ya, nsogbu ahụ akwụsị ma ọ bụ belata.
- 5 Whys: ịjụ "Gịnị mere?" ugboro ugboro, ihe dị ka ugboro ise, iji ruo n'isi nsogbu.
Nwaa ugbu a: Gbakọọ ụdị ntụpọ ọ bụla site na check sheet gị, hazie ha ma see Pareto chart n'akwụkwọ ma ọ bụ na spreadsheet. Wee dee 5 Whys maka mkpanaka kacha ogologo. Kwụsị mgbe ị ruru ihe kpatara ị nwere ike idozi, nke na-adịghị ata mmadụ ụta.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ise Pareto chart, ịhọrọ nsogbu kacha ukwuu, na igwu ruo n'isi nsogbu ya site na 5 Whys.

check.q: Pareto chart gị na-egosi: nha ezighi ezi 40, ihe na-efu efu 25, igbu oge 10, mmebi 5. Ebee ka ị ga-amalite?
options: Mmebi, n'ihi na ọ kacha dị mfe
Igbu oge, n'ihi na ndị ahịa anaghị achọ ichere
Nha ezighi ezi, mkpanaka kacha ogologo
check.why: Pareto chart na-agwa gị ka ị malite na mkpanaka kacha ogologo, ebe mmezi na-enyere aka karịa.

check.q: 5 Whys gị kwụsịrị na "onye ọrụ ahụ akpachaghị anya". Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Kwụsị ebe ahụ ma dee akụkọ megide onye ọrụ ahụ
Nọgide na-ajụ ihe mere usoro ahụ ji kwe ka mperi ahụ mee
Wepụ onye ọrụ ahụ na chart
check.why: Ịta ụta abụghị isi nsogbu; chọọ ihe dị n'usoro ahụ kwere ka mperi ahụ mee.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 5: Improve: wepụ ihe efu ma gbochie mperi n'ọrụ
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 5 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Họrọ mmezi na-ewepụ ihe efu ma ọ bụ mperi ma nwalee ya n'obere ọnọdụ.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị isi nsogbu, ị ga-enwe ike ịhọrọ mmezi na-ewepụ ihe efu ma ọ bụ mperi, nwalee ya n'obere ọnọdụ ma hazie nlele njikwa, nwere data tupu na mgbe mmezi ahụ gasịrị.
Lean na-akpọ aha ụdị ihe efu asatọ. Ụzọ dị mfe isi cheta ha bụ DOWNTIME: Defects (ntụpọ), Overproduction (imepụta karịa), Waiting (nchere), Non-used talent (nka a na-ejighị), Transportation (ibuga ihe), Inventory (ngwaahịa karịrị akarị), Motion (ije ma ọ bụ nseru aka karịrị akarị) na Extra processing (ọrụ karịrị akarị).
Ezigbo mmezi na-emekarị ka ụzọ ziri ezi bụrụ ụzọ dị mfe. 5S na-ahazi ebe ọrụ: Sort (họrọ), Set in order (dozie n'usoro), Shine (hichaa), Standardize (mee ka ọ bụrụ otu ụzọ), Sustain (nọgide na ya). Igbochi mperi (poka-yoke n'asụsụ Japan) na-eme ka mperi sie ike ma ọ bụ ghara ikwe omume, dị ka plọg dabara naanị n'otu ụzọ, fọm na-agaghị ezipu ma igbe dị efu, ma ọ bụ igbe ihe nwere agba dị iche iche.
Buru ụzọ nwalee mmezi ahụ n'obere ọnọdụ: otu oge ọrụ (shift), otu tebụl ma ọ bụ otu izu. Nke a bụ pilot. Tụọ ya n'otu ụzọ ahụ dị ka baseline gị ma tụnyere ha. Ọ bụrụ na nọmba ndị ahụ ka mma, gbasaa ya; ọ bụrụ na ọ bụghị, nwalee echiche nke ọzọ.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Depụta mmezi ndị na-awakpo isi nsogbu ahụ.
- Họrọ mmezi na-ewepụ ihe efu ma ọ bụ na-eme ka mperi sie ike.
- Mee obere pilot: otu shift, otu tebụl ma ọ bụ otu izu.
- Tụọ ya n'otu ụzọ ahụ dị ka baseline.
- Tụnyere tupu na mgbe e mezichara.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Ihe efu (waste): nzọụkwụ ọ bụla na-eji oge ma ọ bụ ihe eji arụ ọrụ mana ọ naghị agbakwunye uru nye onye ahịa.
- DOWNTIME: ihe enyemaka ncheta maka ihe efu asatọ: Defects, Overproduction, Waiting, Non-used talent, Transportation, Inventory, Motion, Extra processing.
- 5S: Sort, Set in order, Shine, Standardize, Sustain: ụzọ isi hazie ebe ọrụ.
- Igbochi mperi (poka-yoke): nhazi na-eme ka mperi sie ike ma ọ bụ ghara ikwe omume.
- Pilot: obere nnwale dị mkpụmkpụ nke mmezi tupu e jiri ya ebe niile.
Nwaa ugbu a: Dee mmezi atọ nwere ike ịrụ ọrụ maka isi nsogbu gị. Dee ihe efu nke ọ bụla na-ewepụ ma ọ bụ otu o si egbochi mperi n'ọrụ. Họrọ otu, hazie obere pilot (ebee, ogologo oge ole, onye), ma malite ịtụ ya n'otu ụzọ ahụ dị ka baseline gị.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịmata ihe efu asatọ, ịhọrọ mmezi na-ewepụ ihe efu ma ọ bụ mperi, na ịnwale ya site n'obere pilot.

check.q: Ndị ọrụ na-agafe ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa ọtụtụ ugboro kwa ụbọchị iji were teepu. Kedu ihe efu nke a bụ?
check.why: Ije na nseru aka karịrị akarị nke ndị mmadụ bụ ihe efu nke motion.

check.q: I nwere mmezi i chere na ọ ga-arụ ọrụ. Gịnị bụ nzọụkwụ kacha mma ọzọ?
options: Nwalee ya n'obere ọnọdụ ma tụnyere ya na baseline
Gbasaa ya n'ebe niile n'otu oge
Ghara ịtụ ya, ebe ọ bụ na i ji n'aka
Chere otu afọ ka ị hụ
check.why: Obere pilot a tụrụ dị ka baseline na-egosi ma mmezi ahụ na-arụ ọrụ n'ezie.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 6: Jikwaa uru ahụ, ma hazie ule Yellow Belt gị
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 6 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Hazie nlele njikwa maka mmezi ahụ ma mee atụmatụ ọmụmụ na ule nwere ụbọchị.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị isi nsogbu, ị ga-enwe ike ịhọrọ mmezi na-ewepụ ihe efu ma ọ bụ mperi, nwalee ya n'obere ọnọdụ ma hazie nlele njikwa, nwere data tupu na mgbe mmezi ahụ gasịrị. Site n'iji peeji gọọmentị ASQ ma ọ bụ IASSC, ị ga-enwe ike ime atụmatụ ọmụmụ na ule nwere ụbọchị maka ule Yellow Belt, na ụdị ule na iwu ya a lelere na peeji ahụ.
Ọtụtụ mmezi na-ala n'iyi mgbe ndị mmadụ laghachiri n'omume ochie ha. Na nzọụkwụ Control, ị na-edebe uru ahụ: dee ụzọ ọhụrụ ahụ dị ka standard work (obere ndepụta nlele ma ọ bụ foto nke nzọụkwụ ziri ezi), zụọ ndị mmadụ na ya, ma nọgide na-atụ ya. Run chart na-egosi nọmba gị ka oge na-aga, ya na ahịrị etiti; control chart na-agbakwunye oke na-egosi mgbe usoro ahụ gbanwere karịa ka ọ na-adị. Dee control plan dị mfe: ihe ị ga-elele, ugboro ole, onye na-elele, na ihe a ga-eme ma ọ bụrụ na nọmba ahụ ka njọ.
Ugbu a, hazie asambodo gị. ASQ Certified Six Sigma Yellow Belt achọghị ahụmịhe ọrụ ma ọ bụ agụmakwụkwọ ọ bụla, ule ya bụkwa open book (ị nwere ike iji akwụkwọ nrụtụ aka gị e jikọrọ ọnụ), dị ka asq.org si kwuo. IASSC Certified Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt enweghị ihe a chọrọ tupu, ule ya bụkwa closed book (enweghị akwụkwọ) ma onye nlekọta na-ele ya anya (proctored), dị ka iassc.org si kwuo. Ụdị ule, ụgwọ na iwu na-agbanwe, ya mere gụọ peeji gọọmentị ahụ tupu i debanye aha. Ụfọdụ ndị were mmadụ n'ọrụ na-emekwa ọzụzụ Yellow Belt nke ha n'ime ụlọ ọrụ ha.
Budata Body of Knowledge nke ụlọ ọrụ na-enye asambodo (ndepụta isiokwu ule ahụ nwere ike ịjụ), kaa akara n'isiokwu ọ bụla ị maara, ma hazie oge ọmụmụ maka ndị fọdụrụ. Tinye ezi ụbọchị na kalenda, ma debanye aha maka ule naanị mgbe akara nnwale omume gị kwụsiri ike.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Dee ụzọ ọhụrụ ahụ dị ka standard work.
- Mee control plan: gịnị, ugboro ole, onye, na ihe a ga-eme ma ọ ka njọ.
- Nọgide na run chart opekata mpe izu ole na ole.
- Họrọ ule ma gụọ peeji gọọmentị ya.
- Jiri Body of Knowledge hazie ụbọchị ọmụmụ na ụbọchị ule ị chọrọ.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Standard work: ụzọ kacha mma e kwekọrịtara isi rụọ ọrụ, e dere dị ka nzọụkwụ dị mfe ma ọ bụ foto.
- Run chart: chart ahịrị nke ntụle ka oge na-aga, iji hụ otu ihe si aga.
- Control chart: run chart nwere oke na-egosi mgbe usoro gbanwere karịa ka ọ na-adị.
- Control plan: obere atụmatụ na-ekwu ihe a ga-elele, ugboro ole, onye na-elele na ihe a ga-eme ma ọ dalata.
- Body of Knowledge: ndepụta gọọmentị nke isiokwu ule nwere ike ịjụ.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- ASQ: Certified Six Sigma Yellow Belt (ihe a chọrọ, ule na Body of Knowledge)
- IASSC: Certified Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt (ICYB)
Nwaa ugbu a: Ọrụ ikpeazụ: mechaa ọrụ otu peeji gị (nkọwa nsogbu na ebumnuche, eserese usoro, check sheet na ọnụego ntụpọ, Pareto chart na 5 Whys, mmezi i mere pilot ya na nọmba tupu na mgbe e mezichara, na control plan). Wee meghee peeji Yellow Belt nke ASQ ma ọ bụ IASSC, dee ụdị ule ị hụrụ n'ebe ahụ, ma mee atụmatụ ọmụmụ nwere opekata mpe oge ọmụmụ anọ nwere ụbọchị na ụbọchị ule ị chọrọ.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike idebe uru site na standard work na control plan, na ịgbaso atụmatụ nwere ụbọchị ruo n'ule Yellow Belt.
Otu e si enyocha ọrụ ikpeazụ gị:
Ihe anyị na-ele anya Ọ bụbeghị O ruru O karịrị Nsogbu na ebumnuche Nkọwa ahụ edoghị anya ma ọ bụ na-akpọ aha ihe kpatara ya ma ọ bụ ngwọta; ebumnuche enweghị nọmba ma ọ bụ ụbọchị. Nkọwa ahụ na-enye gịnị, ebee, kemgbe mgbe ole na otu o si buru ibu; ebumnuche nwere nọmba na ụbọchị; e tinyere eserese usoro nwere nzọụkwụ 5 ruo 8. Ọ nwekwara SIPOC ma ọ bụ na-akpọ aha ihe kacha dị onye ahịa mkpa (CTQ). Data na ọnụego ntụpọ Data erughị 20, ma ọ bụ enweghị nkọwa ntụpọ doro anya. Check sheet nwere opekata mpe data 20 na ọnụego ntụpọ ya na mgbakọ e gosiri. Ọ na-enyekwa DPMO, ma ọ bụ na-egosi na e jiri otu iwu ịgụ ọnụ kwa ụbọchị. Isi nsogbu Enweghị Pareto chart, ma ọ bụ 5 Whys na-akwụsị n'ịta ụta. Pareto chart a haziri site na nke kacha ukwuu ruo na nke kacha nta na 5 Whys na-akwụsị n'ihe kpatara n'usoro nke mmadụ nwere ike ime ihe banyere ya. Ọ na-ejikwa fishbone gosi ihe ndị ọzọ kpatara nke otu ahụ wepụrụ. Mmezi na njikwa E nwaleghị mmezi ahụ, ma ọ bụ enweghị nọmba tupu na mgbe e mezichara. Mmezi e mere pilot ya, nwere nọmba tupu na mgbe e mezichara, na control plan (gịnị, ugboro ole, onye, gịnị ma ọ dalata). Ọ nwekwara standard work ma ọ bụ run chart nke ọtụtụ izu. Akụkọ DMAIC Peeji ahụ na-awụgharị, nzọụkwụ na-efu efu ma ọ bụ adịghị n'usoro. Peeji ahụ na-agbaso Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve, Control n'usoro. Onye na-amụ ihe nwere ike ịkọwa ọrụ ahụ n'erughị nkeji abụọ, dị ka n'ajụjụ ọnụ ọrụ. Atụmatụ ọmụmụ na ule Enweghị ụbọchị, ma ọ bụ e leleghị peeji gọọmentị ọ bụla. Ọ na-akpọ aha ule, ụdị ule a lelere na peeji gọọmentị ya, opekata mpe oge ọmụmụ anọ nwere ụbọchị na ụbọchị ule a chọrọ. Ọ na-ejikọkwa oge ọmụmụ na isiokwu Body of Knowledge ma tinye ụbọchị nnwale omume. Iji gafee: Ruru eru ma ọ bụ Karịrị n'ahịrị ọ bụla. Ọ bụrụ na ahịrị bụ Ọ ruchabeghị, dozie akụkụ ahụ ma nwaa ọzọ.

check.q: Ọnwa atọ mgbe mmezi gasịrị, mperi na-amalite ịrị elu ọzọ. Kedu nzọụkwụ na-efu efu?
check.why: Control na-edebe uru ahụ site na standard work, ọzụzụ na nlele na-aga n'ihu.

check.q: Ebee ka ị ga-elele iwu na ụdị ule Yellow Belt ugbu a?
options: Ozi n'ịntanetị mgbasa ozi ọha (social media)
Enyi gafere ya ọtụtụ afọ gara aga
Mgbasa ozi maka ihe ọmụmụ dị ọnụ ala
Peeji gọọmentị nke ụlọ ọrụ na-enye asambodo, dị ka asq.org ma ọ bụ iassc.org
check.why: Iwu ule, ụdị ya na ụgwọ na-agbanwe; peeji nke ụlọ ọrụ na-enye asambodo n'onwe ya bụ isi iyi a ga-atụkwasị obi.
